name: Wequassett Resort & Golf Club
insider_take: This historic Cape Cod gem sits on 22 acres of pristine Pleasant Bay waterfront, where luxury meets authentic New England charm in one of the region's most exclusive enclaves.
whats_special: Wequassett is the only AAA Five Diamond resort on Cape Cod, featuring its own private beach, championship golf course designed by Geoffrey Cornish, and a collection of cedar-shingled cottages dating back to 1740. The resort's location on Pleasant Bay offers some of the most spectacular sunrises on the East Coast, and it's just minutes from the renowned Chatham Bars Inn area.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room during late summer to witness the annual shark migration - Cape Cod's waters are a crucial habitat for great whites, making for incredible (safe) viewing opportunities from the resort's waterfront.
dont_miss: The resort's signature clambake experience on the private beach, tee time at their secluded 18-hole course with ocean views, and a sunset sail on Pleasant Bay. The nearby Monomoy National Wildlife Refuge is a must-see for nature enthusiasts, home to over 300 bird species and pristine barrier islands.
pros: Championship 18-hole golf course with scenic Cape Cod views
Private beach access on Pleasant Bay with water sports
Multiple dining venues including waterfront restaurants
Luxury spa services and wellness facilities
cons: Premium pricing reflecting luxury resort positioning
Seasonal operation with limited winter availability
